instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 一切處自在無繫，一切時無所過患。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhean Jingfan (蔗菴範禪師語錄): in his Guzisheng Monastery hall address, Zhean Jingfan describes being free and unbound in every place and without fault at every time.
